title: Built an EV sports betting app (EVergreen: +EV Sports Betting)
author: EVergreenSportsBets
selftext:
Built an EV sports betting app because I thought more people should know this exists!

A friend introduced me to EV betting a couple years ago and I was surprised I hadn't heard of it before...

Comparing odds, betting like a sharp and tracking CLV seemed pretty cool but also logical to me after spending some time figuring it out and I made a good deal of profit following +EVs.

But the more I talked to people about it, the more I realized most ppl had never heard of EV betting, which surprised me as well, but also made sense because there are a lot of explanations, tools, and analytics out there. I feel like most people just want to gamble for the fun and thrill of it, not reading into spreadsheets, numbers everywhere, and complicated dashboards.

I just launched Evergreen: +EV Sports Betting as my own solution to that problem, and I didn't want to create another picks service or a massive analytics platform I just wanted to make EV betting simple, easy to share/talk about w/ friends and of course FUN.

The app helps you:  
• Find/understand +EV opportunities across sportsbooks  
• Track your closing line value and P&L  
• Understand whether you’re actually improving or just running hot  
• Learn what separates a good process from short-term luck

Anyone can have a good week betting but the harder question is whether your decisions are actually creating an edge over vegas.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/evergreen-ev-sports-betting/id6792869479

Would genuinely love feedback from anyone interested in sports betting, analytics, or just learning more about EV.
